flow:farmer-scan-journey.statement: A farmer uploads a crop photo in the web app; the photo is POSTed to /api/detect and the app itself signals scan:result when the detection result is rendered. Proves the core scan journey end to end.

amended.statement: A farmer uploads a crop photo in the web app; the photo is sent to the detection API and the app shows the result (status badge + advisory). Proves the core scan journey works against the real DOM and network.
